headline: October 26 Bitcoin Put Skew Widens To 21.97 Vol Points From 14.56
narrative: Bitcoin put skew on the October 26 contract widened to 21.97 vol points from 14.56. The 73,000 put marks 73.82 percent implied volatility, up from 66.4 percent on the morning print, while the 89,000 call marks 51.85 percent against 51.9 percent then. The pipe subtracts call implied volatility from put implied volatility at the strikes nearest 10 percent from spot, and a wider positive gap means downside protection costs more than upside.
author: jordan
